dialog.minted_coins.menu.title: Minted Coins
dialog.minted_coins.menu.body: Mints are merchants that strike coins from ingots. Coins can only come from a mint, so nobody can counterfeit them.
dialog.minted_coins.menu.new.tooltip: Place a mint 2 blocks in front of you and choose the coins it strikes.
dialog.minted_coins.menu.list.tooltip: Every mint with its position and rates, with Teleport and Remove buttons.
dialog.minted_coins.create.title: New mint
dialog.minted_coins.create.body: The mint appears 2 blocks in front of you, named after the item in your main hand. Set a slider to 0 to leave a coin out.
dialog.minted_coins.create.confirm.toolt: 9 coins always melt back into 1 ingot. Below 9 per ingot, the mint keeps the difference.
dialog.minted_coins.help.title: How naming works
dialog.minted_coins.help.mint: The mint is named after the renamed item in your main hand (a name tag renamed in an anvil, for instance), otherwise "Mint #N".
dialog.minted_coins.help.coins: Coins are named after a renamed gold, copper or iron nugget, or renamed prismarine crystals, in your inventory (otherwise "Gold Coin", "Copper Coin", "Iron Coin" and "Diamond Coin"). These items are only read, not consumed.
dialog.minted_coins.help.rates: 9 coins always melt back into 1 ingot, and the mint buys back 9 of its own diamond coins for 1 diamond: below 9 coins, the mint keeps the difference.
dialog.minted_coins.help.small: With small change, the mint also changes each coin into 9 small coins, and 9 of its own small coins back into 1 coin.
chat.minted_coins.no_coin: Choose at least one coin to strike.
chat.minted_coins.remove_ask: Remove the mint %s? Coins it already struck stay valid.
chat.minted_coins.not_loaded: This mint is not loaded right now. %s to it and remove it again, or %s it if it no longer exists.
chat.minted_coins.list.title: Minted Coins · mints
chat.minted_coins.list.empty: No mint yet: /trigger minted_coins to create one.
